opening.argument: The video walks viewers through a purchase in Wealthsimple Trade: search for ADA, enter the amount they want to buy, and review the order before submitting it. The review screen shows the estimated quantity, fee, and total, so the transaction details are presented before the final step. The description expressly says the guide is not financial advice. These observable steps support an instructional purpose: the video explains how to use the trading interface without promising guaranteed returns or directing money to an unrelated recipient.
